summary_1line: Rama organizes the siege of Lanka and sends Angada as a final messenger to warn Ravana, who angrily orders his capture before Angada displays his strength and escapes.

image_candidates.scene_text: Angada leaps onto Ravana’s palace roof with captured demons in his arms, shattering the summit as the court watches in shock.
Rama stands with bow in hand before the towering northern gate of Lanka while vast armies of monkeys and bears surround the city walls.
Dark clouds rain blood as crows and vultures circle low over the trembling earth, foretelling the coming battle.
